chore: bump version to 2.0.1

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: resolve AbortError, NaN progress, missing mute icon in VideoCard

- Await canplay/loadedmetadata before play() to prevent AbortError when
  load() interrupts an in-flight play() request
- Catch AbortError in useMedia play() and clean up interval/state
- Guard timeToPercentage against NaN duration before metadata loads
- Add mute prop to MaterialUIMediaProps and forward it in VideoCard
- Fix .gitignore to scope /public to root only (was matching src/stories/public)
- Configure storybook staticDirs to serve local assets from .storybook/assets

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
